title: MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.29154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves

translated_title: MVAgent：全局协调下的逐视频智能体用于多视频理解
translated_abstract: 多视频理解要求系统能够整合来自不同视频的证据以进行跨视频推理。回答这类问题涉及两类决策：观察决策必须适应每个视频的内容，而跨视频判断则需要根据问题关联来自不同视频的证据。大多数现有智能体在单一控制器中同时做出这两类决策，其上下文会不断累积来自每个视频的观察。我们在MVAgent中将这两类决策分离，这是一个免训练的多视频理解智能体框架，每个视频配备一个LocalAgent。每个LocalAgent规划自己视频的观察并维护私有的观察历史。GlobalAgent则通过指示各LocalAgent并将它们的报告与联合观察相结合来协调跨视频推理。我们在CVBench、MVU-Eval和CrossVid上，使用三个不同规模的Qwen3.5模型以及GPT-6-sol对MVAgent进行评估。使用Qwen3.5时，我们的框架提升了……
tldr: 提出免训练的多视频理解框架MVAgent，通过为每个视频配备独立的LocalAgent处理观察决策，并由GlobalAgent协调跨视频推理，将观察与跨视频判断两类决策解耦。
en_tdlr: MVAgent is a training-free multi-video understanding framework that decouples observation decisions from cross-video judgments by assigning a per-video LocalAgent under the coordination of a GlobalAgent.
